page.overview:
Who is Ali Hand'el Bar ben ibn ben Khazi?

Ali Hand'el Bar ben ibn ben Khazi is a 29-year-old Arabyan assassin.

Ali serves as Don Roberto y Monterrey's assassin, and his skills in stealth, the use of poison, and silent killing are second to none. Though he appears calm and almost relaxed, he is always ready for danger and strikes with deadly efficiency when needed.

Ali's loyalty to Don Roberto stems from his desire to learn more about herbal poisons, a craft he has already mastered to a great extent. His demeanor is impassive, and he rarely speaks of himself, though he is fluent in both Reikspiel and Estalian, acting as a translator for Don Roberto when needed.

In combat, Ali wields a magical scimitar and a dagger. His gear includes a Turban of Toughness that grants him resistance to magical attacks. He also wears a sleeved mail shirt under his robes for added protection.
